about_the_game:
Once, a sacred well sustained Ravy’s hometown with endless blessings. But one day, the well mysteriously ran dry. The land withered, prayers went unanswered, and hope began to fade. Refusing to wait for miracles, Ravy chose to set out on a journey—seeking the legendary land of Norveranda, where the source of blessings is said to lie.

This game is a narrative-driven adventure about exploration, gentle encounters, and the search for hope. As you guide Ravy through unfamiliar lands, you’ll uncover secrets, meet kindred spirits, and piece together the story of a world once touched by light.

  • A gentle yet mysterious story about farewell, pursuit, and homecoming.

  • Journey through warm forests, misty swamps, and more, with new discoveries on every map.

  • Meet NPCs, collect items, and unlock interactions—your choices shape Ravy’s path.

  • Gather scattered pearls and memory fragments to uncover the secret of Norveranda.

  • A delicate hand-drawn art style combined with soft, soothing music creates a warm and healing adventure.

short_description: Ravy embarks on a heartfelt journey to Norveranda, a land only spoken of in legends. Guided by blessings and cherished memories, he must face trials, gather precious fragments of his past, and restore hope to his fading hometown.
